reviews.comment: Chen was a great prof, and she provided plenty of extra credit(test corrections, seminar reports, quizzes)- DO IT! Exams can be tricky, and she loves tricky questions but its important to get at least >75. Never miss class!- Pop quizzes are extra credit and can save your grade. Slides are super helpful but she doesn't post annotated slides.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes
